description_en: Queries the export directory information of a protocol service
description_zh: 查询协议服务导出目录信息
kebab_example: aliyun nas get-protocol-mount-target --file-system-id cpfs-099394bd928c0000 --protocol-service-id ptc-197ed6a00f2b0000 --export-id exp-19abf5beab8d0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetProtocolMountTarget

parameters.help_en: If the response is truncated, you can use NextToken to send a subsequent request to retrieve the content after the current truncation point
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of results to return per query.

Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
每次查询结果的个数。

取值范围：10~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The file system ID.

CPFS: The ID must start with `cpfs-`, such as cpfs-125487\\.

CPFS for Lingjun: The ID must start with `bmcpfs-`, such as bmcpfs-0015\\.
CPFS SE: The ID must start with `cpfsse-`, such as cpfsse-022c71b134\\
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统ID。

CPFS：必须以`cpfs-`开头，例如cpfs-125487\\。

CPFS智算版：必须以`bmcpfs-`开头，例如bmcpfs-0015\\。
CPFS  SE：必须以`cpfsse-`开头，例如cpfsse-022c71b134\\
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may vary for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性，从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。

ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html。

若用户未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The protocol service ID. Required.

How to obtain: Call the DescribeProtocolService (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/cpfs/cpfsonecs/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-describeprotocolservice-cpfs) operation to query the list of protocol services and obtain the ProtocolServiceId from the response
parameters.help_zh:
协议服务 ID。必填参数。

获取方式：调用 DescribeProtocolService (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/cpfs/cpfsonecs/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-describeprotocolservice-cpfs?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-111536.d_4_1_4_8_3.4707210a8yHZsX&scm=20140722.H_2402283._.OR_help-T_cn~zh-V_1) 接口查询协议服务列表，从返回值中获取 ProtocolServiceId
parameters.name: protocol_service_id

parameters.help_en:
The export directory ID of the protocol service. Required.

How to obtain:
Call CreateProtocolMountTarget (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/cpfs/cpfsonecs/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-createprotocolmounttarget-cpfs) to create an export directory and obtain the ExportId from the response.
Or call DescribeProtocolMountTarget (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/cpfs/cpfsonecs/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-describeprotocolmounttarget-cpfs) to query the list of export directories and obtain the ExportId from the response
parameters.help_zh:
协议服务导出目录 ID。必填参数。

获取方式：
调用 CreateProtocolMountTarget (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/cpfs/cpfsonecs/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-createprotocolmounttarget-cpfs?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-111536.d_4_1_4_8_6.3dce2415wDzjQO&scm=20140722.H_2402286._.OR_help-T_cn~zh-V_1) 创建导出目录后，从返回值中获取 ExportId。
或调用 DescribeProtocolMountTarget (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/cpfs/cpfsonecs/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-describeprotocolmounttarget-cpfs?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-111536.d_4_1_4_8_7.67152eb8kCm2NU&scm=20140722.H_2402287._.OR_help-T_cn~zh-V_1) 查询导出目录列表，从返回列表中获取 ExportId
parameters.name: export_id

NextToken.description_en: If the response is truncated, you can use NextToken to send a subsequent request to retrieve the content after the current truncation point
NextToken.description_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容

ProtocolMountTarget.description_en: The export directory information of the protocol service
ProtocolMountTarget.description_zh: 协议服务导出目录信息

AccessGroupName.description_en:
The permission group name.

Default permission group: DEFAULT_VPC_GROUP_NAME
AccessGroupName.description_zh:
权限组名称。

默认权限组：DEFAULT_VPC_GROUP_NAME

CreateTime.description_en:
The creation time.
Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
CreateTime.description_zh:
创建时间。
返回格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

Description.description_en: The description of the protocol service export
Description.example: 此协议服务导出的描述。

Path.description_en:
The path of the queried CPFS directory.

Format:
The path is 1 to 1,024 characters in length.
The path is encoded in UTF-8.
The path must start and end with a forward slash (/). The root directory is `/`
Path.description_zh:
查询到的CPFS目录的路径。

格式：
长度为1~1024个字符。
使用UTF-8编码。
必须以正斜线（/）开头和结尾，根目录为`/`

ProtocolMountTargetDomain.description_en: The domain name of the protocol service export directory
ProtocolMountTargetDomain.description_zh: 协议服务导出目录的域名

ProtocolType.description_en:
The protocol type of the file system.

Valid values:

NFS: NFS protocol
SMB: SMB protocol
cpfs: the protocol type supported by CPFS file systems
ProtocolType.description_zh:
文件系统协议类型。

包括：

NFS：NFS文件协议
SMB：SMB文件协议
cpfs：CPFS文件系统支持的协议类型

Status.description_en:
The status of the protocol service export directory. Valid values:
CREATING: Being created.
AVAILABLE: Available.
MODIFYING: Being modified.
DELETING: Being deleted.
STOPPING: Being stopped
Status.description_zh:
协议服务导出目录的状态。包括：
CREATING：创建中。
AVAILABLE ：可用。
MODIFYING：修改中。
DELETING：删除中。
STOPPING：停止中

VSwitchId.description_en: The vSwitch ID of the protocol service export
VSwitchId.description_zh: 协议服务导出的交换机ID

VSwitchIds.description_en: The list of vSwitch IDs of the protocol service export
VSwitchIds.description_zh: 协议服务导出的交换机 ID 列表

items.description_en: The vSwitch ID of the protocol service export
items.description_zh: 协议服务导出的交换机ID

VpcId.description_en: The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID of the protocol service export
VpcId.description_zh: 协议服务导出的专有网络ID
